# Data Quality, Labelling and Pipelines for Analysis

> Build the labels, rules, contract and gated pipeline an analysis depends on, and trace a figure that changed. SDAIA Academy course DS-311, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 20,803 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Labels are measurements](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/slides/day1.md): Write, pilot and measure a labelling guideline; sessions: What a label measures, Writing a guideline, Agreement statistics, Adjudication and revision; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/slides/day1.html; about 5,979 tokens
- [Day 2: Golden sets and labelling operations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/slides/day2.md): Run a rater team with gold questions, queues and a cost; sessions: Sampling a golden set, Gold questions and review queues, Rater drift and workload, Cost and model pre-labels; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/slides/day2.html; about 4,742 tokens
- [Day 3: Rules and contracts](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/slides/day3.md): Turn analysts' requirements into rules and a contract; sessions: Profiling to rules, Rules with severity, Duplicates and merchant matching, A data contract; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/slides/day3.html; about 4,755 tokens
- [Day 4: Pipelines for analysis](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/slides/day4.md): Package the preparation as a gated, traceable pipeline; sessions: From notebook to pipeline, Gates in the pipeline, Tracing a changed figure, Handing over prepared data; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/slides/day4.html; about 3,693 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone project presentations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/slides/capstone.md): A labelled, quality-gated table for Al-Ghadaf Municipality, reviewed live with a seeded defect; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/slides/capstone.html; about 1,162 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Label 40 complaints, then compare](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D1_1_label_40_complaints.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Guideline v1.0 for six categories](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D1_2_write_definitions_rules.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Kappa and alpha on the pilot](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D1_3_compute_kappa_alpha.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Adjudicate 30, revise, measure again](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D1_4_adjudicate_30_disagreements.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: A stratified golden set](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D2_1_draw_stratified_golden.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Gold checks and routing](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D2_2_set_gold_question.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Find the drifting rater](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D2_3_find_drifting_rater.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Cost per accepted label](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D2_4_compare_cost_per.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Profile four tables, propose rules](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D3_1_profile_four_source.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Warning and blocking rules](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D3_2_implement_warning_blocking.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Merchant names across two scripts](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D3_3_match_merchant_names.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A contract that rejects a breaking change](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D3_4_write_contract_prepared.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Steps, a runner and a lock file](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D4_1_convert_preparation_notebook.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Quarantine and block](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D4_2_make_pipeline_quarantine.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Why the August rate changed](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D4_3_use_run_logs.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: The datasheet's preparation section](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-311/labs/D4_4_write_preparation_section.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
